noChildren.reason: no one is left to raise children

fullYear.title: A full year
fullYear.detail: The world has turned through a whole year of seasons.

hundredSouls.title: A hundred souls
hundredSouls.detail: Your people number {goal} or more at once.

village.title: A village
village.detail: A tribe has grown into a village.

threeTribes.title: Three tribes
threeTribes.detail: Three separate tribes are alive at the same time.

grandchildren.title: Grandchildren
grandchildren.detail: Someone alive is a grandchild or a later descendant of the first people.

ruler.title: A ruler
ruler.detail: A tribe has crowned a ruler who is still alive.

elder.title: An elder
elder.detail: A grown person has lived long enough to be called an elder.

toolmakers.title: Toolmakers
toolmakers.detail: Someone alive carries a tool they made or were given.

firstRoad.title: The first road
firstRoad.detail: The people have laid a road across the land.

roadNetwork.title: A road network
roadNetwork.detail: {goal} cells of road laid across the land.

overTheWater.title: Over the water
overTheWater.detail: A bridge carries the people across a river or a lake.

plea.danger: beg to be saved from beasts
plea.peace: pray for the war to end
plea.shelter: pray for shelter from the cold
plea.fire: beg the gods to put out the fire

foundingFamily.title: Founding family
foundingFamily.detail: A couple with children settles the middle of the land, and their kin are crowned leader.

twoTribes.title: Two rival tribes
twoTribes.detail: Two groups of five start on opposite sides of the land, each with a little wild game nearby.

wildValley.title: Wild valley
wildValley.detail: A herd of deer and rabbits is placed through the land, with a clear sky to start.

apocalypse.title: Apocalypse
apocalypse.detail: A storm breaks over the land, a meteor falls in the middle, a plague spreads, and zombies walk the edges.

goldenAge.title: Golden age
goldenAge.detail: Clear skies, a bounty of food and warm sun over the middle, and two families founding their tribes on the good ground.

tribalWar.title: Tribal war
tribalWar.detail: Two families found rival tribes on either side of the land, and the gods set them at war.

islandSurvival.title: Island survival
islandSurvival.detail: A band of six starts in the middle with deer and rabbits about, and rain to drink.

iceAge.title: Ice age
iceAge.detail: Snow falls and a blizzard sweeps the middle while a small band and a few bears are left to endure it.
